preconditions.description: The number of cities in Byteforces is between 1 and 123456, and the number of cities being attacked is between 1 and the number of cities in Byteforces.
Each road connects two distinct cities within the range of city numbers.

preconditions.expression: The input cities being attacked are distinct and given in no particular order.
preconditions.description: The cities being attacked are provided as a list of distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: The output is the number of the city Super M should teleport to.
postconditions.description: The output must be an integer representing the city number where Super M should start her journey.

postconditions.expression: The output is the minimum possible time needed to scare all humans in cities being attacked.
postconditions.description: The output must be an integer representing the minimum time in krons.

invariants.expression: The road system forms a tree.
invariants.description: The given roads connect the cities in such a way that any city can be reached from any other city using the roads.

invariants.expression: Super M can teleport from Codeforces to any city in Byteforces exactly once.
invariants.description: The special device in Codeforces allows for a single teleportation to any city in Byteforces.
